lead_note.detail: The state's Lead Service Line Inventory Public Transparency Dashboard shows what each public water system reported about the service line at an address, on both the utility side and the private side. Search your street address there. Some utilities also publish their own inventories, linked below. Checked October 14, 2026.
lead_note.headline: Delaware publishes service line inventories by address on a statewide map.
